about.heading: About
about.leadHtml: Mausritter Tools is a small set of browser-based helpers for Mausritter, the tabletop roleplaying game of brave mice by Isaac Williams.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
paragraphsHtml: The whole app is a static site that runs in your browser. There is no server, no account and no analytics, and nothing you generate is uploaded anywhere. A settlement is produced purely from its seed, so the same link always rebuilds the same settlement.

Locking a value freezes it in place so that re-rolling everything else leaves it alone. Editing a value locks it too. Because locks and hand edits would make a link unwieldy, the address bar carries only the seed and the generator settings; the full state travels through the JSON export, and is kept in your browser's local storage between visits.

official.heading: What is official, and what is not
paragraphsHtml: The settlement tables, the tavern table, the non-player mice tables, gear prices, hirelings and spells are all taken from the Mausritter SRD, which is published under CC BY 4.0. They are imported directly from the SRD source rather than retyped, so the wording is the author's own.

Mausritter has no shops or services table. The SRD says only that taverns appear in hamlets and larger, that warbands can be recruited in a town or city, that human-made goods are found near human populations, that a bank charges 1% to retrieve what it holds, that repairs cost 10% of an item's price per usage dot, and that “the size of the settlement determines what types of hireling are available” without ever saying how. Everything else about shops in this tool — which services exist, how size gates them, their stock, quirks and names — is an unofficial house rule original to this project. Each shop shows the SRD rule it was extrapolated from, so you can see where the line falls.
Mouse names are also original. The SRD contains no name tables, and the lists used by the official generator are not published under a licence that permits reuse.

translation.heading: About the German edition
paragraphsHtml: The German version of this tool is an unofficial fan translation by the mausritter-tools contributors. It is not the official German edition of Mausritter, is not endorsed by Losing Games, and no official German translation was used as a source. CC BY 4.0 permits translation as long as the change is declared, which is what this notice does.

A settlement does not change when you change language. Every table is translated row for row, so the same seed produces the same place in both languages and a link shared between a German and an English player shows the same settlement — only the words differ.

source.heading: Source
paragraphsHtml: The code, the imported tables and the importer script are on GitHub.

support.heading: Support Mausritter
paragraphsHtml: This tool is no substitute for the game. Mausritter is pay-what-you-want in digital form and well worth owning: mausritter.com.

sections.officialNoticeHeading: What is official and what is not.
sections.officialNoticeHtml: The settlement, tavern and non-player mice tables come from the Mausritter SRD. Mausritter has no shops or services table, so that whole layer — which services exist, how settlement size gates them, and the mouse names — is original to this tool. Each shop lists the SRD rule it was extrapolated from under “where this comes from”.
